invariants: active scope metadata has a matching claim and owner
unowned scope metadata is not retained in the BUSY store
queue selection, priority, blocked, completed, and handoff scheduling are outside coordinator authority
legacy-only claims remain distinct from coordinator-managed ownership metadata
python and rust cores expose the same required ownership commands
installed wrappers expose the same contract and observability commands
runtime may add compatible metadata but may not omit required commands
new and renewed claim owners identify an approved harness plus task/session suffix; cleanup/recovery may address legacy owner strings
sweep removes only exact-store temp files at least 60 seconds old whose encoded writer PID is positively dead; fresh, live, malformed, unknown-writer, and unrelated temp files are preserved
new path-like relative claims are rejected; filesystem scopes must be absolute or namespaced logical identifiers such as <repo>:file:<path>
